question: The average of first 154 even numbers is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The average of the first n even numbers is directly given by the formula (n + 1).

Here, the number of even numbers (n) = 154.

Average = 154 + 1 = 155.

**∴ The correct answer is 155.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of terms (n) = 154

Sequence of even numbers = 2, 4, 6, ...

**Formula Used:**

Average of an Arithmetic Progression (A.P.) = (First term + Last term) ÷ 2
